articles.title: Clashing Through the Snow review – Amazon’s Christmas romcom is a bust
articles.feed_excerpt: The Summer I Turned Pretty’s Christopher Briney and 1923’s Michelle Randolph try their best, but this chaotic cross-country journey is not worth taking Credit where credit is due: it takes some nerve for Amazon to open its latest holiday romcom, Clashing Through the Snow, with characters bemoaning the enervated state of the book industry. Publishing isn’t the cultural epicenter it once was, reports boutique press head Jeremy (PJ Byrne) before announcing some impending new year’s layoffs. Alas, things have changed – “if Faulkner were alive today, he’d be making ASMR videos with Mr Beast” (or, perhaps, competing on Prime Video’s Beast Games?) Self-awareness can be key to the ludicrous joys of a Christmas romcom confection, though Clashing Through the Snow, starring 1923’s Michelle Randolph and homegrown Amazon star Christopher Briney (The Summer I Turned Pretty), tests one’s patience for beating you to the branded punchline. Briney’s Ryan, a numbers-driven, macro-counting kind of book editor, pitches a “financial trends with benefits” romance that could be “Rebecca Yarros big”. Soulmates, says Randolph’s rival workhorse editor Hannah, are as mythical as “ethical billionaires and pain-free bikini waxes”. Due to said budget cuts, both have a week to land “a book so big it makes Harry Potter look like a Buzzfeed listicle” for only one to keep their job. But there are plenty more gripping stories waiting for their turn in the spotlight There comes a time in the life of every film enthusiast when they must set aside foolish fictions and face up to some hard truths. Specifically, that time arrives each November in the form of the International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam (IDFA for short), with its tales of crisis and strife, angry resistance and everyday human kindness. The world’s largest documentary festival plays out in the city’s twinkling downtown district, quite near the torture museum, and provides a sharp corrective to the confected dramas and A-list pageantry of Cannes, Toronto and Venice. The forecast is bracing, stormy, and occasionally chilling. Hours of darkness; no stars. We might not wish to live in the world IDFA shows us, but unfortunately we do, and so it pays to stay informed, be engaged. This year’s lineup of 250-plus documentaries steers us around the geopolitical hot spots, from tales of forced displacement in the West Bank to the rolling hell of Gaza; from a jungle-based guerrilla army in Myanmar (in White Tiger Column, the event’s opening night film) through to the traumatised children of the Vietnamese boat people (Carol Nguyen’s superb Still Night, Burning House). Some of these films could have been torn from the headlines. articles.title: 【足本】看神州｜中俄美元首深圳會晤 京無人機新規促跨城託管
articles.feed_excerpt: 亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議，日前在深圳圓滿閉幕。其後中俄美領導人歷史性舉行三方會晤，由國家主席習近平主持，會後發表《中俄美元首和平宣言》，重申核戰爭打不贏也打不得，三國將就減少核風險、防止核擴散進行對話。 習近平在APEC會議上又強調，中國是亞太經濟合作的倡導者、推動者、先行者，中方願同各方攜手搭建亞太共同體的「四樑八柱」。 北京繼禁飛無人機後，本月15日起進一步收緊管制，全市禁止持有或存放無人機。新規管造就「跨城託管」商機，不少北京民眾將無人機寄存在鄰近的天津。商戶說，由10月底起累計已收到幾百個查詢或訂單。 內地算力產業前景廣闊，實施「東數西算」工程、構建全國一體化算力網，是黨中央的重要部署。學者認為，西部地區因土地及氣候等因素，算力成本較低，「東數西算」有助優化資源調度。 河北滄州東光縣有村莊被揭暗藏大量非法危險化學品工廠，危及居民安全，這些化工企業竟然由村支書操控，被質疑存在利益輸送。 編輯：汪溟曦

articles.title: 港澳辦稱選委會選舉展現符合香港實際高質量民主新氣象

articles.title: 學者稱「東數西算」工程是國家全盤規劃戰略 形容是天時地利人和
articles.feed_excerpt: 國家主席習近平早前到內蒙古烏蘭察布考察時表示，算力産業正處在加速發展階段，實施「東數西算」工程、構建全國一體化算力網，是中共中央一項重要部署。 城大計算學院副院長王詩淇接受本台節目《看神州》訪問表示，人工智能需要算力，算力要有較好的製冷條件。「東數西算」工程是國家一個全盤的規劃和戰略，因為東部擁有應用場景和數據計算的需求，西部則在風能、水能、天氣等方面有優勢，形容是天時地利人和。至於「東數西算」工程面對的痛點，王詩淇指出，網絡傳輸會遇到延遲，算力亦在硬件、軟件方面有不同規格和型號，有需要調度算力，並建立統一標準和接口來進行計算。 對於習近平表示要注重「算電協同」、「算水協同」，王詩淇分析，算力離不開電力，因為需要冷卻、製冷，同時需要水力，因此涉及非常複雜的系統優化問題，須建立孿生系統，在數字世界中追蹤、預測到「算電協同」、「算水協同」的狀態。 數據安全方面，他認為某些數據有私隱信息，因此需要分級處理可流通的數據，而近年「隱私計算」技術取得長足發展，可在數據安全的情況下，最大化為工業界、學術界提供更好的支持。 他又說，西部的地方政府可以利用「東數西算」工程，積累大量不同領域的人才，促進農業、工業製造等傳統產業的發展。 編輯：譚佩貞

articles.title: 北京進一步嚴禁市內持有或存放無人機 衍生「跨城託管」商機
articles.feed_excerpt: 北京市繼早前全面禁飛無人機後，本月15日起進一步收緊管制，禁止在市內持有或存放無人機及核心部件。在京津高鐵半小時生活圈下，不少用家選擇將無人機轉移至天津存放，帶動新型的「跨城託管」商機。 天津一間售賣無人機的門市，兩個月前推出託管服務，收費每年由300多至800多元人民幣不等，除了提供專屬儲存空間，亦包辦定期充電、檢查及國內異地寄遞服務。負責人說，由上月底開始寄存需求不斷上升，至今已收到數百個查詢及訂單。 當局早前提供免費寄遞出京、報廢及回購三種處置渠道，並推出補貼政策，到指定回購地點出售無人機，可獲成交價30%、上限3000元的補貼，報廢則每部補貼200元。有用家說，因回購價偏低，與原價相差六至七成，因此選擇「跨城託管」作為過渡方案。 北京市公安部門強調，將持續加大對「黑飛」等違法違規行為的查處力度。根據規定，違規持有或攜帶無人機進入北京範圍，會被沒收設備，個人最高罰款5千元；若涉及違規飛行或情節嚴重，更會被追究法律責任。 編輯：黃佩珊

articles.title: Rate-distortion Assessment for Hierarchical Content Summarization
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2611.25151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Powerful generative models including large language and vision models have demonstrated success across a wide range of content generation, editing and manipulation tasks via end-to-end prompt-based generation. However, current assessment of the quality of generative content manipulation remains subjective, limiting scientific understanding of model capabilities. Inspired by rate-distortion theory from Shannon information compression theory, in this work we formalize hierarchical content summarization as an information encoding problem. We design a principled framework to extract the semantic hierarchy of the source content to support quantitative characterization of the rate-distortion trade-off between compression efficiency (rate) against information loss (distortion) during generative content manipulation, which allows us to benchmark various models with respect to performance conditional on rate budget of interest. We demonstrate the use of the framework with empirical experiments on content summarization for long-context question-answering with state-of-the-art large language models, offering new insights into their efficiency and comprehension capabilities. We further demonstrate the use of the semantic hierarchy as guidance for performing effective retrieval augmented generation, showing improved rate-distortion characteristics against current baselines.
